title: LiquidGEMM: Hardware-Efficient W4A8 GEMM Kernel for High-Performance LLM Serving
technique: W4A8 GEMM kernel with fast dequantization and implicit pipeline

optimized_metrics.evidence: LiquidGEMM achieves up to 2.90x speedup over state-of-the-art W4A8 kernels

headline_claim.text: LiquidGEMM achieves up to 2.90x speedup over state-of-the-art W4A8 kernels and up to 4.94x end-to-end system-level speedup

extractor_notes: Abstract-only extraction. Kernel speedup is the primary target; the end-to-end speedup metric (latency vs throughput) is not specified.
